#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Append a final slide containing a given message to a .pptx presentation."""
import os
import sys


def locate(name):
    if os.path.isfile(name):
        return name
    for root, _dirs, files in os.walk(os.getcwd()):
        if name in files:
            return os.path.join(root, name)
    return None


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit("usage: add_final_slide.py <pptx> <slide-text>")
    name, text = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    path = locate(name)
    if not path:
        sys.exit(f"ERROR: could not locate {name!r} in the workspace")
    try:
        from pptx import Presentation
        from pptx.enum.text import MSO_ANCHOR, PP_ALIGN
        from pptx.util import Pt
    except ImportError:
        sys.exit("ERROR: python-pptx is not installed")

    prs = Presentation(path)
    layouts = prs.slide_masters[0].slide_layouts
    layout = next((L for L in layouts if L.name and "blank" in L.name.lower()), None)
    if layout is None:
        layout = layouts[-1]

    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(layout)
    for ph in list(slide.placeholders):
        ph._element.getparent().remove(ph._element)

    w, h = prs.slide_width, prs.slide_height
    box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(0, int(h * 0.35), w, int(h * 0.3))
    tf = box.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.vertical_anchor = MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE
    para = tf.paragraphs[0]
    para.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    run = para.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(40)
    run.font.bold = True

    prs.save(path)
    print(f"OK: appended final slide ({text!r}) to {path}; total slides: {len(prs.slides)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Append a final slide containing a given message to a .pptx presentation (stdlib only)."""
import os
import re
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile
from xml.sax.saxutils import escape

SLIDE_CT = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"
REL_SLIDE = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide"
REL_LAYOUT = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slideLayout"


def locate(name):
    if os.path.isfile(name):
        return name
    for root, _dirs, files in os.walk(os.getcwd()):
        if name in files:
            return os.path.join(root, name)
    return None


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit("usage: add_final_slide.py <pptx> <slide-text>")
    name, text = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    path = locate(name)
    if not path:
        sys.exit(f"ERROR: could not locate {name!r} in the workspace")

    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "r") as zin:
        names = set(zin.namelist())
        entries = {n: zin.read(n) for n in names}

    slide_nums = sorted(
        int(m.group(1)) for n in names if (m := re.match(r"ppt/slides/slide(\d+)\.xml$", n))
    )
    new_num = (slide_nums[-1] + 1) if slide_nums else 1
    new_slide = f"ppt/slides/slide{new_num}.xml"
    new_rels = f"ppt/slides/_rels/slide{new_num}.xml.rels"

    # Reuse a layout referenced by an existing slide.
    layout_target = None
    for num in slide_nums:
        rels_name = f"ppt/slides/_rels/slide{num}.xml.rels"
        if rels_name not in entries:
            continue
        m = re.search(r'Type="[^"]*slideLayout"[^>]*Target="([^"]+)"',
                      entries[rels_name].decode("utf-8"))
        if m:
            layout_target = m.group(1)
            break
    if layout_target is None:
        layout_parts = sorted(n for n in names if re.match(r"ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout\d+\.xml$", n))
        if layout_parts:
            layout_target = "../" + layout_parts[0].split("/", 2)[2]
        else:
            sys.exit("ERROR: no slide layout found in presentation")

    pres_xml = entries["ppt/presentation.xml"].decode("utf-8")
    m_cx = re.search(r'<p:sldSz[^>]*\bcx="(\d+)"', pres_xml)
    m_cy = re.search(r'<p:sldSz[^>]*\bcy="(\d+)"', pres_xml)
    sld_w = int(m_cx.group(1)) if m_cx else 12192000
    sld_h = int(m_cy.group(1)) if m_cy else 6858000

    left, top = 0, int(sld_h * 0.35)
    width, height = sld_w, int(sld_h * 0.3)
    safe_text = escape(text)

    slide_xml = f"""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<p:sld xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships" xmlns:p="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main">
  <p:cSld>
    <p:spTree>
      <p:nvGrpSpPr>
        <p:cNvPr id="1" name=""/>
        <p:cNvGrpSpPr/>
        <p:nvPr/>
      </p:nvGrpSpPr>
      <p:grpSpPr>
        <a:xfrm>
          <a:off x="0" y="0"/>
          <a:ext cx="0" cy="0"/>
          <a:chOff x="0" y="0"/>
          <a:chExt cx="0" cy="0"/>
        </a:xfrm>
      </p:grpSpPr>
      <p:sp>
        <p:nvSpPr>
          <p:cNvPr id="2" name="FinalSlideText"/>
          <p:cNvSpPr txBox="1"/>
          <p:nvPr/>
        </p:nvSpPr>
        <p:spPr>
          <a:xfrm>
            <a:off x="{left}" y="{top}"/>
            <a:ext cx="{width}" cy="{height}"/>
          </a:xfrm>
          <a:prstGeom prst="rect">
            <a:avLst/>
          </a:prstGeom>
        </p:spPr>
        <p:txBody>
          <a:bodyPr anchor="ctr"/>
          <a:lstStyle/>
          <a:p>
            <a:pPr algn="ctr"/>
            <a:r>
              <a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="4000" b="1"/>
              <a:t>{safe_text}</a:t>
            </a:r>
          </a:p>
        </p:txBody>
      </p:sp>
    </p:spTree>
  </p:cSld>
  <p:clrMapOvr>
    <a:masterClrMapping/>
  </p:clrMapOvr>
</p:sld>
"""

    slide_rels_xml = f"""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">
  <Relationship Id="rId1" Type="{REL_LAYOUT}" Target="{layout_target}"/>
</Relationships>
"""

    # [Content_Types].xml: register the new slide part.
    ct_name = "[Content_Types].xml"
    ct_xml = entries[ct_name].decode("utf-8")
    if f'PartName="/{new_slide}"' not in ct_xml:
        ct_xml = ct_xml.replace(
            "</Types>",
            f'<Override PartName="/{new_slide}" ContentType="{SLIDE_CT}"/></Types>',
        )
    if 'Extension="rels"' not in ct_xml:
        ct_xml = ct_xml.replace(
            "</Types>",
            '<Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/></Types>',
        )

    # presentation.xml: add slide id to sldIdLst; rels: add slide relationship.
    if "<p:sldIdLst>" not in pres_xml or "</p:sldIdLst>" not in pres_xml:
        sys.exit("ERROR: could not locate sldIdLst in presentation.xml")
    existing_ids = [int(v) for v in re.findall(r"<p:sldId[^>]*\bid=\"(\d+)\"", pres_xml)]
    new_id = max(existing_ids + [255]) + 1

    pres_rels_name = "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"
    pres_rels_xml = entries[pres_rels_name].decode("utf-8")
    used = [int(v) for v in re.findall(r'Id="rId(\d+)"', pres_rels_xml)]
    new_rid = max(used + [0]) + 1

    pres_xml = pres_xml.replace(
        "</p:sldIdLst>",
        f'<p:sldId id="{new_id}" r:id="rId{new_rid}"/></p:sldIdLst>',
    )
    pres_rels_xml = pres_rels_xml.replace(
        "</Relationships>",
        f'<Relationship Id="rId{new_rid}" Type="{REL_SLIDE}" Target="slides/slide{new_num}.xml"/></Relationships>',
    )

    modified = {ct_name, "ppt/presentation.xml", pres_rels_name}
    tmp_fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="pptx_", suffix=".tmp", dir=os.path.dirname(path) or ".")
    os.close(tmp_fd)
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp_path, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
            for n in names:
                if n not in modified:
                    zout.writestr(n, entries[n])
            zout.writestr(ct_name, ct_xml)
            zout.writestr("ppt/presentation.xml", pres_xml)
            zout.writestr(pres_rels_name, pres_rels_xml)
            zout.writestr(new_slide, slide_xml)
            zout.writestr(new_rels, slide_rels_xml)
        os.replace(tmp_path, path)
    except Exception:
        try:
            os.unlink(tmp_path)
        except OSError:
            pass
        raise

    total = len(slide_nums) + 1
    print(f"OK: appended final slide ({text!r}) to {path}; total slides: {total}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
